subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the
stimulus: sentences need to be written. 1  8 = 8 (a) He thought that it might have been dropped by a passer-by, picked it up and carried it home. (b) He was thinking how he could add to his income. (c) Once there lived a farmer in a village who had a few acres of land. (d) One day, he was walking through the fields. (e) He showed it to his wife who advised him to use it or at least a part of it for themselves. (f) The lands yielded him some crops and he maintained his family with great difficulty. (g) But as he was more than honest, he began to find out the owner of the purse instead of using it. (h) In the meantime, he came across a purse of gold. Part−B : Writing Test [50 Marks]
guide_solution: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 c f d b h a e g Once there lived a farmer in a village who had a few acres of land. The lands yielded him some crops and he maintained his family with great difficulty. One day, he was walking through the fields. He was thinking how he could add to his income. In the meantime, he came across a purse of gold. He thought that it might have been dropped by a passer-by, picked it up and carried it home. He showed it to his wife who advised him to use it or at least a part of it for themselves. But as he was more than honest, he began to find out the owner of the purse instead of using it. Part−B : Writing Test See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 231
